```{r load_libraries}
#| include: FALSE
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
library(crosstalk)
library(leaflet)
```

```{r load_data}
#| include: false
url <- 'https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/dataset/4cc207cc-ff03-44f8-8c5f-415af5224646/resource/9a9f14e1-03ea-4a11-936a-6e77b15eeb39/download/childcare_locations.csv'
bccc <- readr::read_csv(
  url,
  col_select = c(
    FAC_PARTY_ID,
    SERVICE_TYPE_CD,
    NAME,
    ADDRESS_1,
    ADDRESS_2,
    CITY,
    PHONE,
    WEBSITE,
    EMAIL,
    LONGITUDE,
    LATITUDE,
    ECE_CERTIFICATION_YN,
    ELF_PROGRAMMING_YN,
    IS_INCOMPLETE_IND,
    IS_CCFRI_AUTH,
    dplyr::starts_with("LANG_"),
    dplyr::starts_with("VACANCY_")
  )
)
.today <- lubridate::today(tzone = 'Canada/Pacific')

# When BC last re-published the CSV (CKAN metadata); NA if the API is unreachable
bc_resource_api <- 'https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/api/3/action/resource_show?id=9a9f14e1-03ea-4a11-936a-6e77b15eeb39'
bc_published <- tryCatch(
  jsonlite::fromJSON(bc_resource_api)$result$last_modified |>
    lubridate::ymd_hms(tz = "UTC") |>
    lubridate::with_tz("Canada/Pacific") |>
    as.Date(),
  error = function(e) {
    warning("Could not read BC dataset publish date: ", conditionMessage(e))
    as.Date(NA)
  }
)

if (file.exists("data/vacancy_history.csv")) {
  history <- readr::read_csv(
    "data/vacancy_history.csv",
    col_types = readr::cols(
      FAC_PARTY_ID = readr::col_integer(),
      last_vacancy_under36 = readr::col_date(),
      last_vacancy_30mos_5yrs = readr::col_date(),
      last_vacancy_licpre = readr::col_date(),
      last_vacancy_gr1_age12 = readr::col_date(),
      .default = readr::col_skip()
    )
  )
  bccc <- dplyr::left_join(bccc, history, by = "FAC_PARTY_ID")
} else {
  bccc$last_vacancy_under36 <- NA_Date_
  bccc$last_vacancy_30mos_5yrs <- NA_Date_
  bccc$last_vacancy_licpre <- NA_Date_
  bccc$last_vacancy_gr1_age12 <- NA_Date_
}
```

```{r setup_tbl_data}
#| include: false
dataset_last_update <- max(bccc$VACANCY_LAST_UPDATE, na.rm = TRUE)
updated_windows <- c("1d" = 1L, "3d" = 3L, "7d" = 7L, "2w" = 14L)
default_window <- 7L
stale_days <- 14L
data_age_days <- as.integer(.today - dataset_last_update)

# Tap/focus popover. <span tabindex>: Safari won't focus a clicked <button>, and
# Quarto adds href="" to every <a>, which reloads the page on click.
info_icon <- function(text) {
  htmltools::tags$span(
    tabindex = "0",
    role = "button",
    class = "bc-info",
    `data-bs-toggle` = "popover",
    `data-bs-trigger` = "focus",
    `data-bs-placement` = "bottom",
    `data-bs-content` = text,
    `aria-label` = "More info",
    htmltools::tags$i(class = "bi bi-info-circle")
  )
}

if (isTRUE(params$fast_render)) {
  bccc <- bccc |> dplyr::filter(VACANCY_LAST_UPDATE >= dataset_last_update - 3)
}

tbl_data <- bccc |>
  filter(VACANCY_LAST_UPDATE > dataset_last_update - max(updated_windows)) |>
  select(
    SERVICE_TYPE_CD:CITY,
    PHONE:EMAIL,
    LONGITUDE,
    LATITUDE,
    ECE_CERTIFICATION_YN,
    ELF_PROGRAMMING_YN,
    IS_INCOMPLETE_IND,
    IS_CCFRI_AUTH,
    contains('LANG_'),
    contains('VACANCY_')
  ) |>
  select(NAME, everything()) |>
  mutate(
    lbl_under36 = if_else(
      !is.na(last_vacancy_under36),
      paste0(" (last seen ", format(last_vacancy_under36, "%Y-%m-%d"), ")"),
      ""
    ),
    lbl_30mos = if_else(
      !is.na(last_vacancy_30mos_5yrs),
      paste0(" (last seen ", format(last_vacancy_30mos_5yrs, "%Y-%m-%d"), ")"),
      ""
    ),
    lbl_licpre = if_else(
      !is.na(last_vacancy_licpre),
      paste0(" (last seen ", format(last_vacancy_licpre, "%Y-%m-%d"), ")"),
      ""
    ),
    lbl_gr1 = if_else(
      !is.na(last_vacancy_gr1_age12),
      paste0(" (last seen ", format(last_vacancy_gr1_age12, "%Y-%m-%d"), ")"),
      ""
    ),
    maps_query = paste0(ADDRESS_1, ", ", CITY, ", BC"),
    maps_url = paste0(
      "https://www.google.com/maps/search/",
      URLencode(maps_query)
    ),
    popup = glue::glue(
      "<b>{NAME}</b>",
      "{SERVICE_TYPE_CD}",
      "{ADDRESS_1}",
      "{PHONE}",
      "<a href='https://www.google.com/maps/search/{URLencode(paste0(ADDRESS_1, ', ', CITY, ', BC'))}' target='_blank'>Map</a>",
      "<b>Vacancy:</b>",
      "• Under 36m: {VACANCY_SRVC_UNDER36}{lbl_under36}",
      "• 30m–5y: {VACANCY_SRVC_30MOS_5YRS}{lbl_30mos}",
      "• Preschool: {VACANCY_SRVC_LICPRE}{lbl_licpre}",
      "• Gr1–12: {VACANCY_SRVC_OOS_GR1_AGE12}{lbl_gr1}",
      .sep = "<br>"
    )
  ) |>
  select(-starts_with("lbl_")) |>
  mutate(id = row_number()) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      contains('VACANCY_SRVC_'),
      contains('LANG_'),
      ECE_CERTIFICATION_YN,
      ELF_PROGRAMMING_YN,
      IS_CCFRI_AUTH,
      IS_INCOMPLETE_IND
    ),
    names_to = 'name',
    values_to = 'value'
  ) |>
  mutate(
    value = ifelse(
      value == 'Y',
      str_remove_all(name, '^VACANCY_SRVC_') |>
        str_remove_all('^LANG_') |>
        str_remove_all('_YN$'),
      NA
    ),
    value = case_when(
      value == 'ECE_CERTIFICATION' ~ 'Early Childhood Educator (ECE)',
      value == 'ELF_PROGRAMMING' ~ 'ELF',
      value == 'IS_CCFRI_AUTH' ~ 'CCFRI authorized',
      value == '30MOS_5YRS' ~ "30 months - 5 years",
      value == 'UNDER36' ~ 'Under 36 months',
      value == 'LICPRE' ~ 'Licensed Pre-school',
      value == 'OOS_GR1_AGE12' ~ 'Grade 1 - Age 12',
      .default = value
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = value)

shared_data <- SharedData$new(tbl_data, key = ~id)

stat_vac_cols <- c(
  "VACANCY_SRVC_UNDER36",
  "VACANCY_SRVC_30MOS_5YRS",
  "VACANCY_SRVC_LICPRE",
  "VACANCY_SRVC_OOS_GR1_AGE12"
)
stat_any <- as.integer(rowSums(!is.na(tbl_data[, stat_vac_cols])) > 0L)
stat_u36 <- as.integer(!is.na(tbl_data$VACANCY_SRVC_UNDER36))
stat_30 <- as.integer(!is.na(tbl_data$VACANCY_SRVC_30MOS_5YRS))
stat_pre <- as.integer(!is.na(tbl_data$VACANCY_SRVC_LICPRE))
stat_gr1 <- as.integer(!is.na(tbl_data$VACANCY_SRVC_OOS_GR1_AGE12))
stat_total <- nrow(tbl_data)
stat_any_n <- sum(stat_any)
stat_u36_n <- sum(stat_u36)
stat_30_n <- sum(stat_30)
stat_pre_n <- sum(stat_pre)
stat_gr1_n <- sum(stat_gr1)
stat_rate <- if (stat_total > 0L) round(100 * stat_any_n / stat_total, 1) else 0
```

```{r filter_bar_vars}
#| include: false
date_keys_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(tbl_data$id, auto_unbox = FALSE)
date_offsets_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  as.integer(dataset_last_update - tbl_data$VACANCY_LAST_UPDATE),
  auto_unbox = FALSE
)
stat_any_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(stat_any, auto_unbox = FALSE)
stat_u36_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(stat_u36, auto_unbox = FALSE)
stat_30_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(stat_30, auto_unbox = FALSE)
stat_pre_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(stat_pre, auto_unbox = FALSE)
stat_gr1_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(stat_gr1, auto_unbox = FALSE)
```

```{r render_reactable}
#| padding: 0px
#| eval: true
row_details <- function(index, bccc) {
  bccc <- bccc[index, ]
  df_field <- function(name, ...) {
    if (any(is.na(...))) {
      NULL
    } else {
      tagList(div(class = "detail-label", name), ...)
    }
  }

  vac_mark <- function(x) dplyr::if_else(!is.na(x), "Y", "N")
  vac_last <- function(x) {
    dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(x),
      "Never",
      format(x, "%Y-%m-%d")
    )
  }
  lang_cols <- bccc |> dplyr::select(dplyr::contains("LANG_"))
  lang_present <- lang_cols |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      dplyr::everything(),
      names_to = "Language",
      values_to = "present"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(present)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Language = stringr::str_remove_all(Language, "LANG_") |>
        stringr::str_remove_all("_YN")
    ) |>
    dplyr::pull(Language)
  lang_text <- if (length(lang_present) == 0L) {
    "None listed"
  } else {
    paste(lang_present, collapse = ", ")
  }
  vacancy_rows <- list(
    list(
      "Under 36 months",
      vac_mark(bccc$VACANCY_SRVC_UNDER36),
      vac_last(bccc$last_vacancy_under36)
    ),
    list(
      "30 months - 5 years",
      vac_mark(bccc$VACANCY_SRVC_30MOS_5YRS),
      vac_last(bccc$last_vacancy_30mos_5yrs)
    ),
    list(
      "Licensed Pre-school",
      vac_mark(bccc$VACANCY_SRVC_LICPRE),
      vac_last(bccc$last_vacancy_licpre)
    ),
    list(
      "Grade 1 - Age 12",
      vac_mark(bccc$VACANCY_SRVC_OOS_GR1_AGE12),
      vac_last(bccc$last_vacancy_gr1_age12)
    )
  )
  vacancy_table <- htmltools::tags$table(
    class = "vacancy-table",
    htmltools::tags$thead(
      htmltools::tags$tr(
        htmltools::tags$th("Age Group"),
        htmltools::tags$th("Vacancy?"),
        htmltools::tags$th("Last vacancy")
      )
    ),
    htmltools::tags$tbody(
      lapply(vacancy_rows, function(r) {
        htmltools::tags$tr(
          htmltools::tags$td(r[[1]]),
          htmltools::tags$td(r[[2]]),
          htmltools::tags$td(r[[3]])
        )
      })
    )
  )

  detail <- div(
    class = "tbl-detail",
    div(class = "detail-header", span(class = "detail-title", bccc$NAME)),
    div(class = "detail-description", bccc$SERVICE_TYPE_CD),

    bscols(
      div(
        df_field('Last Updated', bccc$VACANCY_LAST_UPDATE),
        df_field("Phone", bccc$PHONE),
        df_field("Website", bccc$WEBSITE),
        df_field("Email", bccc$EMAIL),
        df_field("Address", bccc$ADDRESS_1),
        df_field('Address 2', bccc$ADDRESS_2),
        df_field('City', bccc$CITY),
        df_field(
          'Google Maps',
          htmltools::a(
            "View on Google Maps",
            href = paste0(
              "https://www.google.com/maps/search/",
              URLencode(paste0(bccc$ADDRESS_1, ", ", bccc$CITY, ", BC"))
            ),
            target = "_blank"
          )
        ),
        df_field('ECE_CERTIFICATION_YN', bccc$ECE_CERTIFICATION_YN),
        df_field('ELF', bccc$ELF_PROGRAMMING_YN),
        df_field('IS_INCOMPLETE_IND', bccc$IS_INCOMPLETE_IND),
        df_field('IS_CCFRI_AUTH', bccc$IS_CCFRI_AUTH)
      ),
      div(
        df_field('Latitude', bccc$LATITUDE),
        df_field('Longitude', bccc$LONGITUDE),
        df_field('Language', lang_text)
      )
    ),
    bscols(
      div(df_field("Vacancy type", vacancy_table))
    )
  )
  detail
}

hide <- tbl_data |>
  select(
    contains('VACANCY'),

show <- list(
  VACANCY_LAST_UPDATE = colDef(name = 'Last Updated'),
  NAME = colDef(name = 'Name'),
  CITY = colDef(name = 'City')
)

coldefs <- purrr::list_flatten(list(hide, show))

reactable(
  shared_data,
  defaultSorted = "VACANCY_LAST_UPDATE",
  defaultSortOrder = "desc",
  defaultColDef = colDef(
    headerClass = "header",
    align = "left"
  ),
  onClick = "expand",
  resizable = TRUE,
  columns = coldefs,

  pagination = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 25,
  searchable = TRUE,
  theme = reactableTheme(
    searchInputStyle = list(

    )
  )
)
```

# Info

Data is downloaded every day from the BC government [BC Data Catalogue](https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/dataset/child-care-map-data/resource/9a9f14e1-03ea-4a11-936a-6e77b15eeb39). However, the government does not necessarily update the dataset every day. This data also powers the [Child Care Map](https://maps.gov.bc.ca/ess/hm/ccf/), which the BC government maintains.
